notes.title: Dream Garden Dev Diary #4 - Animals, Item customization, Photomode and more
notes.content:
Welcome back, peaceful gardeners! 🌿

It's been two months since the last developer diary. And we haven't been idle. During this time we managed to make a lot of progress and would like to share it with you

[h2]Animals[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/99959ff2b9697d7153b126c006e1928a3a3175ab.png[/img]
We received a lot of feedback on how you would like to see the animals and here they are. The first animals are already in the game. Among them: koi carp, turtle, frog and crane.

[h2]Item Customization[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/76d7434838169f08a57d163937514fe083aaab42.png[/img]
Now all items can be changed the way you want them. You can change the color, turn on or off the glow of the object, adjust the brightness of the glow, adjust the sound coming from the object, as well as for trees you can adjust the number of leaves on the tree and much more. 

[h2]Photomode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/78cc2940c6a958abc46aff72c67ae4dd68081026.png[/img]
We've also added a photo mode. Everyone wants to capture their progress, right? Now you can do it very easily, as well as edit your photo by adding depth of field, contrast, saturation and other filters

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Dynamic DOF
[*] Now game has soundeffects and music
[*] Added season flow feature (similar to day/night flow)
[*] All ui elements now have juicy animations
[*] Items appearing/disappearing animations were improved
[*] Game was localized to all supported languages
[*] We added some custom cursors to show interactions
[/list]

We'd appreciate if you add our game to your wishlist and tell your friends about our tiny game ❤️

notes.title: Dream Garden Dev Diary #3 - Better UX
notes.content:

In our latest development diary, we’re excited to share what we’ve been working on over the past month. It’s been a productive time, and we’ve made great progress on several fronts.

[h2]Better Tool UI[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/48a6c1ba9be5670cb206e9fb7e317947dd24c1fc.png[/img]
We redesigned the UI for each of the tools, making it clearer, neater and less distracting to the player

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/ff9e8d63c07d13114076589fa097fdec440e1a1d.png[/img]

[h2]Tooltips[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/cbfa23bd263724204930c544cdd49c4427777833.jpg[/img]
We have improved tooltips, added them for all instruments and now they show hotkey if there is one.

[h2]Improved Item Editing UI[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/190d72481afe01424c483e8ce180ac0c837d1da2.png[/img]

notes.title: Dream Garden Dev Diary #1 - New Locations
notes.content:
Hello world! 👋

We would like to thank everyone who is following our game and give you an update on how the development is progressing. So sit back and make yourself a cup of tea. ☕️

If you've stumbled upon our game for the first time and don't know what it is yet - we recommend you to watch the trailer 👉

[previewyoutube=CqQOjIoNTfg;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CqQOjIoNTfg[/previewyoutube]

This month we have been working on adding new locations to our game. At the moment we have 4 almost finished locations that we would like to share with you.

[h2]Room[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/9c050125010abe952697d5d558c88df6a0010572.png[/img]
A standard location that many of you have already seen and probably played in.

[h2]House[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/f1660e3179dd93fc67f440d327f566cf997948db.png[/img]
The first of the new locations - which is a garden that is inside a modern house. Admit it, who would like to have a zen garden at home?

[h2]Backyard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/c59aa8e829f310db060ec075e00918ba2118e464.png[/img]
The second new location is the backyard of a Japanese style house. I think many of you may have seen such designs browsing the internet.

[h2]Room 2[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322893/eee3d07229fdff04d06bedcc55b2e997eddedaca.png[/img]
And the third new location is a more modern apartment where the garden is in the center of the room and sets the mood of the interior. 

And before you go, please consider wishlisting our game if you haven't already - it lets us know how much interest there is, and helps the game gain visibility ❤️

Thanks for joining us on this adventure✨
Campfire Studio
